apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/chatgpt_s.name: ChatGPT sign-in routes
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/chatgpt_s.description: Gives the Secret card OpenAI's sign-in address, takes the address the owner pastes back and settles the card like a saved key, and signs the ChatGPT plan out.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/messages..name: Messages
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/messages..description: Reads a conversation's history for the owner, sends a new message, lets the owner unlock a sent card to edit it, and sets or clears a quick reaction.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/mobile_up.name: Phone app updates
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/mobile_up.description: Serves over-the-air updates and their files to the phone app; a public, read-only feed that only hands out an update already published.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/model_rou.name: Model routing settings
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/model_rou.description: Reads and sets the rules for which AI model answers, their backups, and the context limits; once a model is set, replies that had failed only for the lack of one are tried again.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/onboardin.name: First-time setup
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/onboardin.description: Reports whether the owner account has been set up yet, and creates it on first run.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/opportuni.name: Trading opportunities
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/opportuni.description: Lists the trading opportunities an agent has spotted, and reads one.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/owner_act.name: Owner action cards
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/owner_act.description: Lists the cards asking the owner to decide something, including an agent's Mandate card, and records the owner's decision or a fresh card for an expired one.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/peer_mess.name: Peer messages
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/peer_mess.description: Messages between agents, offered through the shared resource requests.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/performan.name: Agent results
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/performan.description: Shows an agent's trading results grouped by the kind of judgment, counting only trades the broker confirmed as closed.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/providers.name: AI providers
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/providers.description: Lists the AI model providers, saves a provider's key, and lists its models from Lonora's list.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/push_devi.name: Push registration
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/push_devi.description: Registers or removes this phone so it can receive push notifications.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/routines..name: Scheduled routines
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/routines..description: Creates, lists, edits and deletes an agent's scheduled routines, and shows a routine's run history.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/runs.py.name: Agent runs
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/runs.py.description: Lists, starts and reads agent runs, and retries or resumes one that failed or stopped.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/scratchpa.name: Scratchpad
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/scratchpa.description: An agent's scratchpad notes, offered through the shared resource requests.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/search.py.name: Search
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/search.py.description: The owner's unified search across their content; an empty search returns the recent feed.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/secret_ca.name: Secret card
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/secret_ca.description: Handles the single submit of a Secret card: it stores the typed values as workspace secrets, sets up the connection or model key that uses them (checking the key first), and confirms it in the conversation.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/tasks.py.name: Tasks
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/tasks.py.description: Lists, creates, reads and controls an agent's tasks, and lets the owner mark one done without approving or running anything.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/threads.p.name: Conversations
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/threads.p.description: Lists, opens, creates and deletes conversations, reads the inbox, marks threads read, sets per-chat options such as web search, and clears a conversation's history for the owner.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/tickets.p.name: Tickets
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/tickets.p.description: Starts work on a ticket from a board.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/trading_d.name: Past trading decisions
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/trading_d.description: A read-only replay of the owner's past trading decisions; it starts no new trades.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/trading.p.name: Trading
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/trading.p.description: Manages broker connections, reads account and journal, runs a simulation, carries out a trade, and handles the receipts and the owner's approvals that gate it.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/trusted_s.name: Trusted sources
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/trusted_s.description: Lists, adds, removes and restores the sources the owner trusts, and previews or trusts an outside AI connection's tools; owner session only.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/usage.py.name: Usage & cost
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/usage.py.description: Reports how much the owner's agents and models have been used and what it cost, per agent, per model and over time, with a spreadsheet export; a view only, never a cap.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/version.p.name: App version
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/version.p.description: Reports the version of the web app that is being served, so an open screen can notice when a newer one is live.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/voice.py.name: Voice sessions
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/voice.py.description: Starts and ends a live voice session with an agent, reports its status, and handles the transcript and interruptions.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/watches.p.name: Watches
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/watches.p.description: Lets the owner cancel, pause, resume or extend any of their running watches.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/webhook.p.name: Incoming webhook
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/webhook.p.description: Receives a message from an outside service that wakes an agent.

apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/workspace.name: What is running
apps/api/src/lonora_api/routes/workspace.description: Shows every task running in the workspace with the agent that started it, and stops one or all of them with a tap.

GET /threads/{thread_id}/messages.name: Read a conversation
GET /threads/{thread_id}/messages.description: Returns a conversation's messages for the owner, hiding anything before a cleared point and optionally centred on one message from a search.

POST /threads/{thread_id}/messages/{mess.name: Unlock a sent card
POST /threads/{thread_id}/messages/{mess.description: Unlocks a card the owner already sent so they can edit it; if its work hasn't started, that submission is cancelled and replaced.

PUT /threads/{thread_id}/messages/{messa.name: React to a message
PUT /threads/{thread_id}/messages/{messa.description: Sets the owner's one quick reaction on a message, replacing any previous one.

DELETE /threads/{thread_id}/messages/{me.name: Remove a reaction
DELETE /threads/{thread_id}/messages/{me.description: Clears the owner's reaction from a message.

POST /threads/{thread_id}/messages.name: Send a message
POST /threads/{thread_id}/messages.description: Sends the owner's message into a conversation, which starts the agent working on a reply.

GET /mobile/updates.name: Get a phone update
GET /mobile/updates.description: Hands the phone app the latest published over-the-air update for its platform and channel.

GET /mobile/updates/assets/{filename}.name: Get an update file
GET /mobile/updates/assets/{filename}.description: Serves one file belonging to a phone-app update, checked against its fingerprint.

GET /settings/models.name: Read model rules
GET /settings/models.description: Returns the rules for which AI model answers.

PUT /settings/models.name: Set model rules
PUT /settings/models.description: Saves the rules for which AI model answers, and retries replies that had been waiting for a model to be chosen.

PUT /settings/models/backups.name: Set backup models
PUT /settings/models/backups.description: Saves the fallback models used when the first choice can't answer.

GET /settings/models/context.name: Read context limits
GET /settings/models/context.description: Returns how much past conversation the models are given.

PUT /settings/models/context.name: Set context limits
PUT /settings/models/context.description: Changes how much past conversation the models are given.

GET /onboarding.name: Setup status
GET /onboarding.description: Reports whether the owner account has been created yet.

POST /onboarding.name: Create owner account
POST /onboarding.description: Sets up the owner account on first run.

GET /trading/opportunities.name: List opportunities
GET /trading/opportunities.description: Lists the trading opportunities agents have spotted.

GET /owner-actions.name: List action cards
GET /owner-actions.description: Lists the cards waiting for the owner to decide something.

GET /owner-actions/mandate.name: Current Mandate card
GET /owner-actions/mandate.description: Returns an agent's live Mandate card — the newest pending or tapped one — or nothing when it has none.

POST /owner-actions/mandate.name: Show Mandate card
POST /owner-actions/mandate.description: Brings up an agent's Mandate card when the owner asks for it.

POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/challenge.name: Confirm by device
POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/challenge.description: Asks the owner's trusted device to sign off on an action card before it takes effect.

POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/decision.name: Decide an action card
POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/decision.description: Records the owner's decision on an action card.

POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/renew.name: Renew an action card
POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/renew.description: Issues a fresh card for an expired one that still needs a decision.

GET /agents/{agent_id}/performance.name: Agent results
GET /agents/{agent_id}/performance.description: Returns an agent's trading results by kind of judgment, from broker-confirmed closed trades.

GET /providers.name: List providers
GET /providers.description: Lists the AI model providers the settings screens know about.

PUT /providers/{provider}/credential.name: Save provider key
PUT /providers/{provider}/credential.description: Saves the key for one AI provider.

GET /providers/{provider}/models.name: Provider's models
GET /providers/{provider}/models.description: Lists the models one provider offers.

POST /providers/{provider}/discover.name: Discover provider models
POST /providers/{provider}/discover.description: Asks a provider for its current list of models.

PUT /push/devices/{device_id}.name: Register for push
PUT /push/devices/{device_id}.description: Registers this phone to receive push notifications.

DELETE /push/devices/{device_id}.name: Stop push
DELETE /push/devices/{device_id}.description: Removes this phone from push notifications.

POST /routines/{agent_id}.name: Create a routine
POST /routines/{agent_id}.description: Adds a scheduled routine for one agent.

PUT /routines/{routine_id}.name: Edit a routine
PUT /routines/{routine_id}.description: Changes a routine; anything left out keeps its saved value.

GET /routines/{routine_id}/history.name: Routine history
GET /routines/{routine_id}/history.description: Shows when a routine has run and what happened.

POST /runs/{run_id}/retry.name: Retry a run
POST /runs/{run_id}/retry.description: Re-runs a failed reply for the same message, as a new run with the same input.

POST /runs/{run_id}/resume.name: Resume a run
POST /runs/{run_id}/resume.description: Continues a run that was paused or stopped.

GET /search.name: Search
GET /search.description: Searches the owner's content; an empty search returns the recent feed.

POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/secret.name: Submit a Secret card
POST /owner-actions/{card_id}/secret.description: Saves the values typed into a Secret card as workspace secrets, sets up the connection or model key that uses them, and confirms it in the conversation.

GET /tasks.name: List tasks
GET /tasks.description: Returns one agent's latest tasks, or the owner's latest across all agents.

POST /tasks/control.name: Control a task
POST /tasks/control.description: Pauses, resumes or stops a task.

POST /tasks/{task_id}/complete.name: Mark task done
POST /tasks/{task_id}/complete.description: Ends a task as done for the owner; it approves and runs nothing.

GET /threads/inbox.name: Conversation inbox
GET /threads/inbox.description: Returns the inbox of conversations needing attention.

POST /threads/prefs.name: Update many preferences
POST /threads/prefs.description: Changes settings on several conversations at once.

PUT /threads/{thread_id}/options.name: Set conversation options
PUT /threads/{thread_id}/options.description: Sets a conversation's options, such as having the agent gather sources from the web first.

POST /threads/{thread_id}/clear.name: Clear a conversation
POST /threads/{thread_id}/clear.description: Hides a conversation's history for the owner; the conversation, its grants and the agent stay.

POST /{ticket_id}/start.name: Start a ticket
POST /{ticket_id}/start.description: Begins work on a board ticket.

GET /trading/decisions.name: Trading decision history
GET /trading/decisions.description: Lists the owner's past trading decisions, read-only.

GET /trading/accounts/{connection_id}.name: Broker account
GET /trading/accounts/{connection_id}.description: Returns the account behind one broker connection.

POST /trading/connections/{connection_id.name: Set up simulation
POST /trading/connections/{connection_id.description: Sets up imported simulation data for a broker connection.

POST /trading/execute.name: Place a trade
POST /trading/execute.description: Carries out a trade after the on/off and emergency-stop controls allow it.

GET /trading/journal.name: Trading journal
GET /trading/journal.description: Returns the record of trading activity.

GET /trading/receipts.name: Trade receipts
GET /trading/receipts.description: Returns the receipts for the trades carried out in one conversation.

GET /trading/approvals.name: Trade approvals
GET /trading/approvals.description: Lists the trades waiting for the owner's approval.

POST /trading/approvals/{approval_id}/de.name: Decide a trade approval
POST /trading/approvals/{approval_id}/de.description: Records the owner's approval or refusal of a trade.

POST /trading/approvals/{approval_id}/re.name: Renew a trade approval
POST /trading/approvals/{approval_id}/re.description: Asks the agent again in the same conversation when a trade approval has expired.

GET /trusted-sources.name: List trusted sources
GET /trusted-sources.description: Lists the sources the owner trusts.

POST /trusted-sources.name: Add a trusted source
POST /trusted-sources.description: Adds a source to the owner's trusted list.

POST /trusted-sources/{source_id}/revoke.name: Remove a trusted source
POST /trusted-sources/{source_id}/revoke.description: Takes a source off the owner's trusted list.

POST /trusted-sources/{source_id}/restor.name: Restore a trusted source
POST /trusted-sources/{source_id}/restor.description: Puts a removed source back on the trusted list.

POST /trusted-sources/mcp/{connection_id.name: Preview a connection's tools
POST /trusted-sources/mcp/{connection_id.description: Reads an outside AI connection's tools so the owner can see them before trusting it.

POST /trusted-sources/mcp/{connection_id.name: Trust a connection
POST /trusted-sources/mcp/{connection_id.description: Trusts an outside AI connection's tools.

GET /usage/summary.name: Usage summary
GET /usage/summary.description: Returns a short summary of usage and cost.

GET /usage/agents.name: Usage by agent
GET /usage/agents.description: Returns how much each agent used the models over a chosen number of days.

GET /usage/series.name: Usage over time
GET /usage/series.description: Returns cost and usage per hour or day against the previous equal period, with the month so far and a projection.

GET /usage/rank.name: Usage ranking
GET /usage/rank.description: Returns the period's usage per agent and per model, most costly first.

GET /usage/export.csv.name: Export usage
GET /usage/export.csv.description: Exports the usage-over-time figures as a spreadsheet file.

GET /version.name: App version
GET /version.description: Returns the version of the web app being served.

POST /voice/sessions.name: Start a voice call
POST /voice/sessions.description: Opens a live voice session with an agent.

POST /voice/sessions/{session_id}/transc.name: Save voice transcript
POST /voice/sessions/{session_id}/transc.description: Records what was said in a voice session.

POST /voice/sessions/{session_id}/interr.name: Interrupt the agent
POST /voice/sessions/{session_id}/interr.description: Cuts in while the agent is speaking in a voice session.

GET /voice/status.name: Voice status
GET /voice/status.description: Reports whether voice is available and set up.

GET /voice/sessions/{session_id}.name: Voice session status
GET /voice/sessions/{session_id}.description: Reports the status of one voice session.

POST /voice/cancel-initialization.name: Cancel voice setup
POST /voice/cancel-initialization.description: Stops a voice session that is still starting up.

POST /{watch_id}/control.name: Control a watch
POST /{watch_id}/control.description: Cancels, pauses, resumes or extends one of the owner's watches; extending moves its end time later.

POST /webhook.name: Receive a webhook
POST /webhook.description: Takes in a message from an outside service that wakes an agent.

GET /workspace/running.name: List running tasks
GET /workspace/running.description: Shows every task running in the workspace and which agent started it.
